transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this meeting. As you know, one of our students has completed a three-day suspension following the cafeteria altercation and is scheduled to return to school next Monday. Before I can approve a return-to-school behavior plan, our re-entry policy requires me to gather current implementation information from classroom, counseling, and family-support staff. The plan also needs to address supervision during unstructured periods, daily check-ins, extracurricular participation, and communication with the student's caregiver. I'd like to go around and hear from each of you on what you're seeing on your end so we can build a solid plan together. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'd be happy to start, Dr. Morgan. From the classroom side, I've had some recent observations during transitions that I think are very relevant to the supervision and check-in components of this plan. I'd like to share those with the group.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Bell. I'd appreciate hearing your observations, especially as they relate to supervision and check-ins. From the counseling side, I have some important information to share regarding the student's extracurricular activities that will need to be addressed in the plan, but please go ahead first, Ms. Bell.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Bell and Mr. Shah. I'd like to share some important information from the family-support side before we get too far into building the plan. I spoke with the student's caregiver by phone yesterday, and there are some key details about how we'll need to handle the communication component of this plan that the group should know about.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Thank you all for being ready to share. That way we have the full picture before I make any decisions on the plan. Ms. Ortega, please go ahead.
